header.description: Held-out scoring of the layer-15 head masks of addition_heads_dbm_fit_l15.json on Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B: load one L1 weight's fitted head gate (3 here; the workflow sets the entry for each weight), swap the kept heads' attention_premix from the counterfactual problem at '=' with no training, and save how often the next token is the counterfactual's tens digit (iia) or the base's (null), which workflows/scripts/addition_heads_dbm/heads_figure.py draws; the workflow also points it at size-matched random masks, and the bundle fit_l15/gate.safetensors is a run-tree path that only the workflow resolves, so this document does not validate on its own.
